layout.name: Time Grouping Range
layout.layoutData:
<report-filter>
  <display><#
   // (C) 2003 Lombardi Software, All Rights Reserved. For use with the TeamWorks platform only.
   //
   // This is a generic layout filter for any Drop-Down Selection model. Just copy this layout
   // and change the 'values' and 'labels' variables under to match your selection.
   //
   // The values are the actual text being replaced in the twql, while the labels is the text
   // the end user will see in his dropdown combo.
   //
   // NOTE: Always have the same number of values as labels. There are no checks anywhere for
   // this, but it is required in order for the combobox to work.
   //

   // >>>> START CONFIGURATION
   var values = "time_stamp_day,time_stamp_week,time_stamp_month,time_stamp_year".split(",");
   var labels = "Days,Weeks,Months,Years".split(",");
   // >>>> END CONFIGURATION




#>
<select name="<#= filter.formName #>">
<#
   var selectedValue = filter.value;

   for (var i = 0 ; i < values.length ; i++) {
       isSelected = (selectedValue == values[i])  // Replace with real filter settings
#>
      <option value="<#= values[i] #>" <# if (isSelected) { #>SELECTED<# } #>> <#= labels[i] #></option>
<#
   }
#>
</select>

</display>
  <script>return filter.value;
</script>
</report-filter>
layout.description: Switches between which field to use between the time_stamp_xxx fields provided by TWQL.
